title: Whiteboards
subtitle: Free-form boards for brainstorming, flows and planning. Draw, add sticky notes and turn ideas into tasks.
newHint: Name it and, if you like, link it to a project. Project boards follow the project’s visibility.
emptyText: Create a board to work through ideas with your team: sticky notes, arrows, shapes, images and free drawing.
deleteText: The board "{{title}}" and everything on it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
notFound: Board not found, or you do not have access.

tasks.hint: Select sticky notes or texts to turn them into tasks
tasks.title: Create tasks from sticky notes
tasks.description: Each note becomes a task: the first line is the title, the rest becomes the description.
